"""Tests for subject.extract_task_shape and its output features."""

from subject import (
    EnumFileType,
    ModelTaskShapeContext,
    ModelTaskShapeFeatures,
    extract_task_shape,
)


def test_none_context_returns_default_shape():
    features = extract_task_shape(None)
    assert isinstance(features, ModelTaskShapeFeatures)
    assert features.diff_size == 0
    assert features.file_types == frozenset()
    assert features.novelty_score == 0.5


def test_empty_context_returns_defaults():
    features = extract_task_shape(ModelTaskShapeContext())
    assert features.diff_size == 0
    assert features.file_types == frozenset()
    assert features.novelty_score == 0.5


def test_diff_size_sums_added_and_removed():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(diff_lines_added=7, diff_lines_removed=3)
    assert extract_task_shape(context).diff_size == 10


def test_diff_size_with_only_added():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(diff_lines_added=5)
    assert extract_task_shape(context).diff_size == 5


def test_diff_size_with_only_removed():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(diff_lines_removed=4)
    assert extract_task_shape(context).diff_size == 4


def test_diff_size_with_zero_lines():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(diff_lines_added=0, diff_lines_removed=0)
    assert extract_task_shape(context).diff_size == 0


def test_python_extension_classified():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("src/main.py",))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.PYTHON})


def test_typescript_variants_collapse_to_one_type():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("app.ts", "component.tsx"))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.TYPESCRIPT})


def test_yaml_variants_collapse_to_one_type():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("a.yaml", "b.yml"))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.YAML})


def test_markdown_extension_classified():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("README.md",))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.MARKDOWN})


def test_unknown_extension_maps_to_other():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("data.json",))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.OTHER})


def test_path_without_extension_maps_to_other():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("Makefile",))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.OTHER})


def test_extension_matching_is_case_insensitive():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("MODULE.PY", "config.YmL"))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.PYTHON, EnumFileType.YAML})


def test_extension_taken_from_last_dot():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("archive.tar.gz", "pkg/setup.py"))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.OTHER, EnumFileType.PYTHON})


def test_multiple_distinct_file_types_are_collected():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(
        file_paths=("a.py", "b.ts", "c.yml", "d.md", "e.txt")
    )
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset(
        {
            EnumFileType.PYTHON,
            EnumFileType.TYPESCRIPT,
            EnumFileType.YAML,
            EnumFileType.MARKDOWN,
            EnumFileType.OTHER,
        }
    )


def test_repeated_types_are_deduplicated():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("x.py", "y.py", "z.py"))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.PYTHON})


def test_file_types_is_a_frozenset():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("a.py",))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert isinstance(features.file_types, frozenset)


def test_novelty_score_passed_through():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(ledger_novelty_score=0.9)
    assert extract_task_shape(context).novelty_score == 0.9


def test_novelty_score_zero_passed_through():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(ledger_novelty_score=0.0)
    assert extract_task_shape(context).novelty_score == 0.0


def test_novelty_score_one_passed_through():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(ledger_novelty_score=1.0)
    assert extract_task_shape(context).novelty_score == 1.0


def test_novelty_defaults_to_half_when_absent():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(diff_lines_added=2, diff_lines_removed=1)
    assert extract_task_shape(context).novelty_score == 0.5


def test_full_context_combined():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(
        diff_lines_added=12,
        diff_lines_removed=8,
        file_paths=("cli.py", "ui.tsx", "notes.md"),
        ledger_novelty_score=0.25,
    )
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.diff_size == 20
    assert features.file_types == frozenset(
        {EnumFileType.PYTHON, EnumFileType.TYPESCRIPT, EnumFileType.MARKDOWN}
    )
    assert features.novelty_score == 0.25


def test_file_paths_present_with_no_diff_info():
    context = ModelTaskShapeContext(file_paths=("only.rs",))
    features = extract_task_shape(context)
    assert features.diff_size == 0
    assert features.file_types == frozenset({EnumFileType.OTHER})
    assert features.novelty_score == 0.5
